name: Sayonara Made no 30-Ppun
source: “You’re the only one that sees me. Please, lend me your body.” “ECHOLL” a band that disbanded right before its major debut. One day, a year later, Souta, a university student appears in front of Yamaken, Shigeta, and Mori who are ex-members of the band. Souta steps into our everyday lives and encourages us to reform the band. Having a voice that fascinates everyone, and even though he is pushy, there is something about him that you just cannot get mad at. And the members start to feel moved by this. However, the identity of Souta was in fact Aki, the vocalist who died a year before!
translation: “只有你看得见我。求你，把身体借给我。”乐队“ECHOLL”在正式出道前夕解散。一年后的某一天，大学生飒太出现在前成员山健、重田和森面前。他闯入大家的日常生活，力劝众人重组乐队。他有着让所有人为之着迷的歌声，虽然行事强势，却有种令人无法生气的特质。成员们也渐渐被他打动。然而，飒太的真实身份，竟是一年前去世的主唱秋！
